description: Estadística mensual del movimiento portuario de cruceros is a dataset listed in Mexican national open data portal (datos.gob.mx), an open data portal, published or maintained by Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Estadística del movimiento portuario de cruceros para cada uno de los puertos. Coverage: México. The portal files it under the publisher Secretaría de Marina (SEMAR). Its tags are actividad marítima, asunto marítimo, crucero, infraestructura portuaria, instalación portuaria. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2026-04-23 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-mx-portal.
